summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a CSS repo-config but its package.json declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers such as `_0x488df8` and string-lookup maps) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/...`, extracts the archive to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'],...)`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line bundle with a rotated string-array dispatcher (`WV8StW`, `String.fromCodePoint` reconstruction, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that only runs under the freshly dropped Bun binary and cannot be observed by Node-based tooling. A CSS configuration package has no purpose-aligned need for an alternate JS runtime, and the obfuscation of both the dropper and the payload plus execution under a non-Node runtime is an evasion pattern designed to bypass reviewers and Node-based scanners. Installing this version executes attacker-controlled, opaque code at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
